thread:
maria: heads up — PR #456 turned CI red on the e2e-linux matrix. failing test looks flaky: `serving_connection_timeout.test`.
sandeep: ok. we can do a rebuild-only rerun for that specific job to avoid a full image rebuild. that should shave ~10-12m.
ryan: two quick options: (1) from the Actions UI -> open the workflow run -> 'Re-run jobs' -> choose the specific job and select 'Re-run failed jobs'
ryan: or (2) from the CLI — find the run id then rerun the job. example:
```
# find the workflow run for the PR and job
gh run list -R redwood-inference/backend --workflow "e2e-linux.yml" --branch "pr/456"
# rerun the single failed job (replace <run-id>)
gh run rerun <run-id> --job e2e-linux --rebuild false
```
sandeep: our internal helper also supports a shorter command if you prefer a PR comment. post this as a comment on the PR:
```
/ci rerun --pr 456 --job e2e-linux --skip-image-build
```
sandeep: that pings the CI bot and preserves the existing build artifacts/caches.
maria: nice — any flags to keep caches or avoid rebuilding layers? last time caching missed and it still took long.
ryan: yes: set `PRESERVE_BUILDKIT_CACHE=1` in the rerun environment or add `--preserve-cache` if using the helper. example:
```
/ci rerun --pr 456 --job e2e-linux --skip-image-build --preserve-cache
```
sandeep: if the failure is per-shard, you can target the exact shard to avoid rerunning other shards. example: `--shard 2/8` or `--axis shard=2` depending on helper version.
maria: thanks. I'll try the PR comment route with preserve-cache and shard=3/8 (failing logs point to that shard).
ci-bot: triggered rerun for PR 456, job=e2e-linux, shard=3/8, preserve_cache=true. queued run id: 5921348. status: queued :hourglass:
ryan: sweet — if it flakes again, let's bisect by toggling `--shard` ranges and adding `--keep-logs` so we can compare traces. also file a flaky test ticket if it fails >2x.
maria: will do. thanks folks :thumbsup:
